description:
Chandni Chowk is one of the most iconic and chaotic places in India.
Walk through Chandni Chowk, Old Delhi’s most legendary and crowded market.
Explore narrow lanes, spice shops, temples, rickshaws, and street vendors — everything that defines the soul of Old Delhi.
